data.name: SupportedScope
data.value: Bounded control-edge slices: WRITE_DAC, WRITE_OWNER, group-membership rights, password-reset permission, key-credential write permission, replication permissions on captured naming-context roots and existing-owner permission control. General membership writes and own-account-only Self-Membership are separate; named-holder requester operations remain unknown, while explicit bounded requester assessments are separate uncounted detail. Password-reset edges describe permission evidence, not a tested password reset or subsequent sign-in. Key-credential write edges describe permission evidence, not a tested key-credential write or subsequent sign-in. Replication edges describe permission evidence, not performed replication or extracted credentials. Replication groups cover this page only; further edges may appear on other pages. Missing root or authorization-context evidence remains unknown. Ownership and permission evidence only. No owner or permission change was performed. This does not establish account takeover or a completed path to Tier 0. Blocked or unknown existing-owner assessments are not counted; unknown assessments remain unanswered coverage. Owner-change compounds remain unknown and uncounted pending the AD DS laboratory gate. Validated-write-only key-credential access, constrained secret reveal, full-control aggregation and effective member expansion are not yet derived. Counts are not totals for all control capabilities.
